symbolDescription: Props passed to `pinComponent`. Its wrapper is already positioned and rotated to the surface normal.

optionDescriptions.position: Projected position of the pin's surface point.
optionDescriptions.hovered: True while the pointer is over this pin.
optionDescriptions.selected: True after this pin was clicked; a second click, a click elsewhere on the globe, or new `pins` clear it.
optionDescriptions.occluded: True while the pin sits on the far side of the globe.
optionDescriptions.scale: Suggested scale factor for zoom compensation; 1 at the default distance.
